sections.title: MID-MO VLY/NRN PLAINS TO THE UPR GREAT LAKES REGION
sections.text: TSTM CLUSTERS...THRIVING ALONG NOSE OF A VEERING LLJ...WILL BE ONGOING OVER PARTS OF ERN SD AND MN AT 12Z. THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE EWD INTO THE CNTRL GREAT LAKES REGION BY AFTN WHILE WEAKENING IN A MORE STABLE ENVIRONMENT. THE PRIMARY COLD FRONT TIED TO THE PARENT CYCLONE OVER SRN CANADA WILL SETTLE INTO CNTRL ND AND NWRN SD BY 00Z/10. PRIMARY FOCUS FOR SVR STORMS...HOWEVER...WILL BE ALONG THE RESIDUAL OUTFLOW/LEE TROUGH...LIKELY ESTABLISHED FROM CNTRL MN SWWD INTO NCNTRL NEB BY SATURDAY AFTN. AIR MASS ALONG/SE OF THIS FEATURE WILL BE QUITE MOIST WITH SFC DEW POINTS IN EXCESS OF 65 DEG F. THERE IS UNCERTAINTY ON HOW MUCH CLOUD COVER...LEFT BEHIND BY DECAYING MORNING ACTIVITY...WILL INHIBIT DESTABILIZATION OVER CNTRL/NRN MN. MORE CONFIDENCE EXISTS FOR STRONG HEATING FARTHER SW...FROM NCNTRL NEB/SCNTRL SD ENE INTO SWRN MN WHERE MLCAPES COULD APPROACH 2500 J/KG. HERE...AS INHIBITION IS REDUCED /MOSTLY VIA HEATING/... TSTMS WILL LIKELY INITIATE BY LATE AFTN. WEAK ENELY UPSLOPE FLOW IN WAKE OF THE BOUNDARY MAY ALSO FOCUS TSTM INITIATION ACROSS THE ERN SLOPES OF THE BLACK HILLS IN SWRN SD. FCST HODOGRAPHS EXHIBIT SUPERCELLULAR WIND PROFILES /35-40 KTS OF EBS/ WITH POTENTIAL FOR LARGE

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: REGION WILL REMAIN IN WSWLY FLOW ALOFT ON SATURDAY WITH PRECIPITABLE WATER VALUES DECREASING OVER FRIDAY. NONETHELESS...AN AXIS OF UPR 40S/LWR 50S SFC DEW POINTS WILL BE MAINTAINED ALONG THE PALMER DIVIDE REGION THROUGH THE DAY. A FEW TSTMS MAY SURVIVE OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN ONTO THE ADJACENT PLAINS DURING THE LATE AFTN IN ECNTRL CO/NWRN KS. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-45 KTS WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL/GUSTY WINDS. ACTIVITY WILL PEAK DURING THE EARLY EVENING AND DIMINISH WITH EWD EXTENT. ..RACY/GARNER.. 07/09/2011

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: ELONGATED RIDGE WILL REMAIN QSTNRY FROM THE SRN RCKYS TO THE OZARKS THIS PERIOD AS ERN AB CLOSED LOW EDGES E INTO SK...AND UPR TROUGH MOVES FARTHER E OFF THE NEW ENGLAND CST. A SERIES OF WEAK IMPULSES WILL MOVE ENE FROM THE CNTRL RCKYS TO THE CNTRL PLNS/UPR MS VLY...IN BRANCH OF FLOW IMMEDIATELY N OF THE RIDGE. ELSEWHERE...A DISTURBANCE TIED TO THE NEW ENGLAND TROUGH WILL TRACK E/SE ACROSS THE SRN APPALACHIANS/CAROLINAS...WHILE A WEAK UPR LOW MOVES WWD INTO S TX. AT LWR LVLS...COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH AB/SK LOW WILL CONTINUE E ACROSS ND AND THE NRN HALF OF MN LATER TODAY/TNGT...WHILE TRAILING WRN PORTION BECOMES INDISTINCT OVER SD. NRN PART OF PREFRONTAL TROUGH NOW EXTENDING FROM NW MN TO CNTRL NEB/NW KS SHOULD BE OVERTAKEN BY COLD FRONT...WHILE SRN PART REMAINS QSTNRY AND WEAKENS.

sections.title: MID MO VLY/NRN PLNS TO UPR GRT LKS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: TSTMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO WEAKEN OVER THE UPR MS VLY AND PARTS OF THE CNTRL PLNS LATER THIS MORNING AS LLJ CONTINUES TO VEER AND SHIFT NWD INTO CANADA. IN THE WAKE OF THIS ACTIVITY...SFC HEATING SHOULD INITIATE ANOTHER ROUND OF SCTD STORMS BY LATE AFTN FROM CNTRL NEB NEWD INTO SE SD...SRN MN...AND WRN WI...ALONG OUTFLOW LEFT BY THE MORNING CONVECTION...AND ALONG WEAKENING LEE TROUGH. OTHER SCTD STORMS MAY FORM AROUND THE SAME TIME INVOF THE COLD FRONT FROM THE BLACK HILLS REGION E/NE INTO ERN ND. AMPLE MOISTURE /PW AOA 1.50 INCHES/ WILL REMAIN ALONG LEE TROUGH TO SUPPORT STRONG STORMS...ALTHOUGH MODEST MID LVL LAPSE RATES AND...IN ERN MN/WI...CLOUD DEBRIS...MAY TEMPER UPDRAFT STRENGTH. THE GREATEST INSTABILITY SHOULD DEVELOP IN NEB/SE SD/NW IA/SW MN...WHERE SBCAPE COULD EXCEED 3000 J/KG. VALUES TO NEAR 1500 J/KG COULD EXTEND AS FAR W AS THE BLACK HILLS. HODOGRAPHS WITH 40 KT DEEP WLY SHEAR SHOULD SUPPORT A FEW SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY DMGG WIND. A TORNADO OR TWO ALSO CANNOT BE RULED OUT IN THE AXIS OF GREATEST LOW LVL MOISTURE...DESPITE MODEST LOW LVL FLOW. 25-30 KT NOCTURNALLY ENHANCED SW TO WSWLY LLJ MAY FOSTER UPSCALE GROWTH OF THE STORMS INTO ONE OR MORE SMAL

sections.title: CNTRL HI PLNS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: WEAK UPSLOPE FLOW WILL PREVAIL OVER THE CNTRL HI PLNS TODAY...ON N SIDE OF STNRY LEE/THERMAL LOW IN SE CO...AND N OF DIFFUSE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ASSOCIATED WITH WEAKENING MCS NOW IN CNTRL KS/NEB. THE REGION WILL REMAIN BENEATH BRANCH OF 30-35 KT WSWLY MID LVL FLOW ON NRN SIDE OF UPR RIDGE...WITH PW AROUND 1 INCH. WHILE PROXIMITY OF RIDGE WILL KEEP MID LVL LAPSE RATES MODEST...STRONG SFC HEATING SHOULD SUPPORT AFTN STORMS OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF CNTRL CO AND...PERHAPS A BIT LATER...OVER THE PALMER DIVIDE. THE STORMS SHOULD MOVE/DEVELOP E ONTO THE ADJACENT PLNS LATE THIS AFTN/EARLY TNGT. 35-40 KT DEEP WLY SHEAR MAY SUPPORT A FEW SUPERCELLS/SUSTAINED STORMS WITH SVR HAIL/GUSTY WINDS. THE ACTIVITY LIKELY WILL EVOLVE INTO A SMALL EWD-MOVING CLUSTER THAT COULD AFFECT NW KS/SW NEB WITH A DIMINISHING THREAT FOR SVR WIND/HAIL LATER TNGT. ..CORFIDI/SMITH.. 07/09/2011
